_author: Smart Downloads Organiser - made by Sparsh
_comment: OPTIONAL. Copy this file to rules.json and edit it. The tool works fine without it.
_how_it_works: If a file or folder NAME contains a keyword (not case-sensitive), it goes to 'My Folders\<folder>'. First match wins.

rules._comment: Example: anything with 'acme' or 'client-x' in its name goes to My Folders\Work
'folder' must be a single name: no slashes, no drive letters
